I'm checking the atomic coordinates for glutamate residue E162 and tryptophan residue W165, tracking their backbone and side-chain atom positions.

Computing the distance from E162's CA to W165's CD1 atom gives roughly 3.69 angstroms, which is quite close. Checking H166 and other nearby residues shows their distances are all larger, confirming W165 is the closest match.
